items.title: Emerson Electric (EMR) Completed A €750 Million Eurobond Offering
items.summary: Emerson Electric (NYSE:EMR) completed a large Eurobond fixed income offering in the European market in recent days. The industrial group also filed a new universal shelf registration, refreshing its capacity to issue securities in the future. Together, the Eurobond deal and new shelf registration reshape how Emerson Electric can fund upcoming projects and balance sheet needs. Our analysis turns up 2 warning signs for Emerson Electric as well. This funding theme reaches well beyond Emerson...
